content: {"episode_id":"ep-05163","cpt":"93226","denial_carc":"PR-204","necessity_paragraph":"We appeal the PR-204 denial of CPT 93226, the 48-hour Holter monitoring study, which the payer letter states is not covered under the member's current benefit plan. The clinical indication note documents a history of recurrent palpitations consistent with supraventricular tachycardia (I47.1), accompanied by episodes of dizziness (R42) and a recent event of syncope (R55). As stated in the order, the 48-hour Holter monitor was ordered to correlate these symptomatic episodes with potential arrhythmic activity and guide further management. We request reconsideration and payment of the outstanding balance of 153.07 for this medically necessary service."}
